data.body: REMEDIATION_CYCLE:3 plan-review revision — task-2: (AC#13 major) script reads corpus/manifest paths from env-overridable vars (DSO_CORPUS_INDEX/DSO_RUNNER_MANIFEST, defaulting to canonical paths); AC#13 now behavioral: run with DSO_CORPUS_INDEX=/nonexistent -> assert non-zero + loud diagnostic. (AC#8/#10) pin the adapter fixture name to 'suite_engine' (a real manifest verdict_adapter name normalize_verdict must recognize) instead of placeholder 'known_adapter'. (AC#14) keep validate.sh source-grep as documented acceptable fallback (no --list-tests flag exists; behavioral discovery run is cost-prohibitive). task-1: add 'no direct DD ownership; shared infra consumed by task-2/task-3' note. Final cycle.
